voicelessNoTextFrames.definition: All frames without dialogue text (includes staging, waits, transitions, and select cards)

strictPureStagingFrames.definition: Frames without text, voice, select, label, nextLabel, still, waitType, waitTime, or movie

methodologyA_subsequentCharFramesEffecti.definition: Across all subsequent frames of the same charLabel within a script after their initial body pose: strict hold = charAnim1 omitted or equal to active charAnim1; functional idle/hold = strict hold or staying within wait* idle family.

methodologyB_subsequentDialogueTurns.definition: Across subsequent spoken dialogue frames (has text) of the same charLabel within a script.

methodologyC_explicitCharAnim1WritesOnly.definition: Among subsequent frames of the same charLabel that explicitly write a non-empty charAnim1.
